Suraj Kumar   
Phone: 7081506940                               
Email : rjsuraj541@gmail.com  Software Engineer   
Professional Summary   
  
Highly skilled Java Full Stack Developer with 4+ years of experience designing and developing 
scalable, high-performance web applications using Spring Boot, Microservices, Angular, 
Kafka, AWS, and Kubernetes. Strong foundation in System Design, Design Patterns. 
Experienced in RESTful APIs, event -driven architecture, JWT authentication, unit testing (JUnit 
& Mockito), and database optimization. Proficient in Agile/Scrum workflows using Jira.  
Passionate about building clean, maintainable, and production-ready code for enterprise-grade.   
Technical Skills   
  
• Backend: Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Hibernate, JUnit, 
Mockito   
• Frontend: Angular, HTML5, CSS3   
• Database: MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL   
• Architecture & Tools: Microservices, Kafka, REST API, JWT, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS (S3), API 
Gateway   
• Concepts: System Design, Design Patterns (Singleton, Factory, Strategy), OOPs, Multithreading, 
Exception Handling   
• DevOps & CI/CD: Maven, Jenkins, Git, Postman, Swagger   
• Project Management: Jira, Scrum/Agile   
  
Professional Experience   
NextQbicle software technologies private limited   
Java Full Stack Developer                                                        |Nov 2021 – Dec 2025   
- Developed and deployed RESTful APIs using Spring, Spring Boot and Spring MVC.   
- Designed microservices architecture with synchronous (REST) and asynchronous (Kafka) 
communication.   
- Built reusable Angular components and managed frontend-backend integration.   
- Implemented JWT-based authentication and role-based access control.   
- Conducted unit and integration testing using JUnit & Mockito ensuring code reliability.   
- Optimized database queries in MySQL and MongoDB, improving performance by ~40%.   
- Applied SOLID principles and design patterns (Factory, Singleton).   
- Deployed microservices on AWS EC2 with Docker & Kubernetes, configured auto-scaling.   
  
Key Projects   
  
CRM – Customer Relationship Management  
   
Tech Stack: Spring Boot, Microservices, Kafka, Angular, AWS (S3, RDS), MySQL, MongoDB, 
Redis, Kubernetes, API Gateway   
   
- Designed and developed microservices for CRM modules such as Lead Management, 
Contact Management, Sales Pipeline, Campaign Management, Customer Support, and 
Notification Services.   
- Implemented API Gateway with Circuit Breaker patterns and fallback mechanisms to ensure 
high availability.  
- Managed synchronous REST communications between CRM services and asynchronous 
event streaming using Kafka for lead updates, campaign triggers, and support ticket events. - 
Built a workflow/state machine for automated lead-to-customer lifecycle transitions (Lead → 
Qualified → Opportunity → Customer).   
- Implemented Redis caching for frequently accessed CRM data such as leads, customer 
profiles, and campaign metadata.  
- Utilized AWS S3 for storing customer documents, campaign assets, and attachments; 
MongoDB for flexible customer activity logs; MySQL for core transactional CRM records.  
- Developed Angular-based dashboards, lead forms, sales pipeline views, customer 
profiles, and support ticket screens with real-time updates via event streaming.  
  
Marketplace (LOCCA)  
   
Tech Stack:  Spring Boot, JWT, PostgreSQL, AWS, Kubernetes   
   
- Developed backend microservices for Product Management, Seller Management, 
Customer Management, Order Processing, Payments, and Real-Time Deals. - 
Implemented JWT authentication and role-based access control for Admin, Seller, and 
Customer user types.  
- Designed and implemented RESTful APIs for product listing, inventory updates, order 
placement, order tracking, and payment workflows.  
- Built asynchronous workflows using message queues (e.g., Kafka) for order events, 
payment confirmations, and inventory updates.  
- Implemented caching strategies (Redis) for frequently accessed data such as product details, 
price information, and seller performance stats.  
- Ensured performance optimization, centralized logging, monitoring, and containerized 
deployment with Kubernetes, enabling seamless scaling and high availability.   
Education   
  
B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, Dr.A.P.J. Abdul Kalam University, Lucknow  
Additional Highlights   
  
• Experience designing scalable distributed systems with Load Balancer, Cache, and API 
Gateway.   
• Strong knowledge of Microservices best practices, and circuit breaker patterns.   
• Worked in Agile/Scrum environment using Jira for sprint planning and backlog management.
